peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.5% above its local comparables; 18 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (93.6): 4.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 51 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 37.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Dec 2022 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 2 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Clarke Quay MRT about 150 m, Raffles Place MRT about 550 m; closer than 52 of 63 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 2 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 1,520 m; more than 0 of 63 similar developments (the same as 16). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 290 m), more than 36 of 63 similar developments (the same as 2); nearest hawker centre Hong Lim Food Centre And Market about 500 m; nearest park Fort Canning Park about 220 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Hong Lim Food Centre And Market

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 470 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 560 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 850 m; TMW Maxwell, 1 new sales, about 1,160 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,200 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,290 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,380 m; W Residences Marina View - Singapore, 14 new sales, about 1,380 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 188 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,621 new sales and 821 resales (2,442 purchases); new sales were 66.4% of these purchases. Subsales (43) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,620 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 821 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 43 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 821 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 925 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−11.2%). Planning-area private resales −25.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
